name: Satyr of the Night Patriarch

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Shadow Dweller
traits.details: The satyr has partial concealment. Whenever the satyr gains concealment from dim light, the satyr is instead invisible.

hit.description: damage, and ongoing 10 necrotic damage (save ends).

effect.description: The satyr slides the target up to 3 squares.

hit.description: damage, and the target is slowed (save ends).

effect.description: The satyr conjures a living nightmare in an unoccupied square adjacent to each target. A nightmare can be attacked, using the satyr’s defenses, and has 1 hit point. Enemies are immobilized while adjacent to a nightmare. The nightmares last until the end of the encounter if not destroyed.

hit.description: psychic damage, and the satyr slides the target up to the target’s speed.

miss.description: Half damage, and the satyr can slide the target 1 square.

effect.description: The burst creates a zone that lasts until the end of the satyr’s next turn. In the zone, bright light becomes dim light.
